connector.name: Smart Crawler
connector.registryDescription: E-commerce competitor intelligence, VOC sentiment, Amazon ASIN analysis, Reddit growth playbooks.
connector.summary: Hosted at smartcrawler.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shulex-voc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API Key in the form 'Bearer sck_...'. Generate a key in the smart-crawler console under 'API 接入'.
